quarterly_data.signal: GlobalFoundries Q2 2026 interim report (IFRS): Communications Infrastructure & Datacenter revenue was $277 million versus $171 million (+62.0%), primarily driven by growth in data center networking applications using silicon photonics (SiPh) and silicon germanium (SiGe); for the six months it was $507 million (+47.0%). Technology Services revenue was $201 million (+21.1%) on stronger engineering services, royalty and reticle revenue. The blended corporate average selling price fell 3.3% year over year in Q2 (3.8% for the six months), reflecting customer demand patterns within certain end markets; six-month wafer shipments were 1,204 thousand 300mm-equivalent (+7.1%). IFRS gross margin was 28.3% versus 24.2%.
quarterly_data.figure: CID $277 million (+62.0%); Technology Services $201 million (+21.1%); blended ASP -3.3% YoY; IFRS gross margin 28.3%

quarterly_data.signal: GlobalFoundries Q2 2026 interim report: GF said recent global events highlighted the semiconductor industry's vulnerability to materials availability and energy supply, and that its diverse supply chain and resilient sourcing largely insulated it from these impacts; it has experienced increased costs for materials and energy and expects these increases to continue to have an adverse impact while these conditions persist.

GlobalFoundries H1 2026 interim report: purchases of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets were $723 million in the six months ended June 30, 2026 versus $325 million a year earlier; cash used in investing activities rose, among other items, on a $398 million increase in capital expenditures for property, plant and equipment and intangible assets related to manufacturing facility investments.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 capex $723 million (vs $325 million in H1 2025)
